title_en: AKPS officer dead: two children mourn mother's return
summary_en: The death of the 35-year-old Norhazwani Ibrahim, who was killed by her husband in Nilai, Negeri Sembilan, on Thursday night is a major shock to Malaysian society. She died at age 49 after being shot and injured while returning home from an event held for her family in Kampung Banjir, Pengkalan Kubor, here, early Monday morning.
